g.text: REAL LOCAL TIMING // NO VIBES IN THE NUMERATOR
25 warm launch-to-pwd runs / Linux x86_64 / median elapsed / lower is shorter

fish / Zsh / Nushell unavailable locally; no timing result is claimed for them.
